display.purpose: The one-sentence status answer in the Home hero band and the login intro line; key phrase steps to 800. Max 26ch.

greeting.purpose: Time-of-day greeting above the hero sentence, in Navy Secondary Text.

row.purpose: Action-row text: leading verb 700 Ink, remainder 500 Slate Ink; row amounts 700 tabular.

figure.purpose: Loan principal and record figures; always tabular.

body.purpose: Running text; long explanations cap at 72ch with 1.6 line height.

body-sm.purpose: Field labels, figcaptions, progress-track end labels, notification text.

label.purpose: Status chips, table headers, progress bubbles. Sentence case, never uppercase.

wordmark.purpose: "Weenie Beanie" beside the bean tile in the app bar and login.

radii.name: sm
radii.purpose: Brand link focus shape, small nested notes.

radii.name: control
radii.purpose: Inputs, icon buttons, skip link, form errors (--radius-sm).

radii.name: tile
radii.purpose: Icon tiles, the bean tile, bean-claim row, nested notes (--radius-tile).

radii.name: card
radii.purpose: Cards, action lists, popovers, toasts, presenter panel (--radius).

radii.name: pill
radii.purpose: All text buttons, status chips, progress tracks, notification count.

shadows.name: shadow
shadows.purpose: Resting: information cards and action lists; primary button hover lift.

shadows.name: shadow-lift
shadows.purpose: Lifted: offer and active-loan cards, overlays, toasts, and the hover state of interactive cards.

shadows.name: bean-tile
shadows.purpose: The white bean tile sitting on navy.

shadows.name: app-bar
shadows.purpose: The sticky navy app bar only.

shadows.name: focus-outline
shadows.purpose: Global :focus-visible ring; action rows use an inset 3px Focus Blue ring instead.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default decelerating ease for all state transitions, popovers and growth.

motion.name: ease-in-drop
motion.purpose: The planting bean falling into the soil.

motion.name: duration-state
motion.purpose: Colour, border, shadow and transform changes on buttons, rows, chevrons, icon tiles, inputs; skip-link slide.

motion.name: duration-lift
motion.purpose: Interactive card lift (translateY -2px to Lifted); nav underline scaleX from centre.

motion.name: press
motion.value: scale(0.98) buttons; scale(0.99) link cards; scale(0.94) icon buttons and tabs
motion.purpose: Tactile press confirmation on all devices.

motion.name: hover-gate
motion.purpose: All hover-only motion (button lift, card lift, chevron nudge 4px, icon-tile scale 1.06, leaf sway, bean wobble, bell swing) is gated here; touch gets press states.

motion.name: sway
motion.value: 1600ms ease-in-out alternate infinite, rotate -3deg → 4deg, staggered by --d
motion.purpose: Hero, bean-strip and beanstalk leaves on pointer hover.

motion.name: rise
motion.value: opacity 0 → 1, translateY(8px) → 0; 220ms bell panel, 240ms presenter panel, 320ms toast

motion.name: bean-plant
motion.purpose: Bean drops 46px into the soil and fades.

motion.name: stalk-grow
motion.purpose: Stalk stroke draws up to its new height.

motion.name: leaf-unfurl
motion.purpose: New leaf scales from 0 at its base.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: transform animations removed (sway, wobble, bean tile, bell); colour changes stay; beanstalk renders final state

breakpoints.name: stack
breakpoints.purpose: Two-column pages collapse to one; hero overlap shrinks to 48px; sticky asides become static.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Top nav hides; bottom tab bar appears; hero padding 24px × 16px with 40px overlap; popovers become sheets.

breakpoints.name: bar-height
breakpoints.purpose: App bar height; offsets sticky elements.

breakpoints.name: hero-overlap
breakpoints.purpose: First card row rises into the hero band (margin-top: -64px).

components.name: Hero Band
components.description: Navy band opening Home: greeting, Display answer sentence (shortfall in Red on Navy), balance as of, leaf cluster growing from the bottom-right edge.
components.html:
Good morning, Alex

You're short $212.40 in August 2027.

Balance $1,843.10 as of today
components.css: .ds-hero { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(140px, 220px); align-items: end; gap: 24px; padding: 32px 24px 88px; background: var(--navy-900, #0e2a47); color: #fff; font-family: 'Manrope Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; overflow: hidden; } .ds-hero-text { display: grid; gap: 12px; } .ds-hero-greeting, .ds-hero-balance { margin: 0; color: var(--on-navy-2, #c9d6e3); } .ds-hero-greeting { font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-hero-headline { margin: 0; max-width: 26ch; font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 1.15rem + 2vw, 2.65rem); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.14; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-hero-headline strong { font-weight: 800; } .ds-neg { color: var(--red-on-navy, #ff9b93); } .ds-fig { color: #fff; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-hero-leaves { width: 100%; height: auto; margin-bottom: -88px; overflow: visible; } .ds-sway { transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: left center; } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-hero:hover .ds-sway path { animation: ds-sway 1600ms ease-in-out var(--d, 0ms) infinite alternate; transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: left center; } } @keyframes ds-sway { from { transform: rotate(-3deg); } to { transform: rotate(4deg); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-hero .ds-sway path { animation: none !important; } }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Night Navy pill; one per decision. Pointer hover lifts 1px with Resting shadow; press scales 0.98.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 22px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--navy-900, #0e2a47); color: #fff; font-family: 'Manrope Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.95rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--navy-700, #1f4e79); } .ds-btn:active:not(:disabled) { background: var(--navy-800, #163a5f); transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #3a7bc8; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:disabled { background: #8fa0b2; cursor: not-allowed; } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-btn:hover:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(14, 42, 71, 0.06), 0 8px 24px -8px rgba(14, 42, 71, 0.12); } .ds-btn:active:not(:disabled) { transform: scale(0.98); box-shadow: none; } }

components.name: Grow Button
components.description: Growth Green pill used only for actions that plant or grow the bean (e.g. accepting an offer).
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 22px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; color: #fff; font-family: 'Manrope Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.95rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn--grow { background: var(--green-700, #2e7d4f); } .ds-btn--grow:hover { background: var(--green-600, #3d9a5f); } .ds-btn--grow:active { background: var(--green-700, #2e7d4f); transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #3a7bc8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: White pill with Strong Hairline border beside a primary or Grow action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 22px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #c3ced9); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--navy-900, #0e2a47); font-family: 'Manrope Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.95rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--navy-50, #edf3f8); border-color: var(--navy-700, #1f4e79); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #3a7bc8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Labelled 44px field, 10px corners; Harbour Navy border and Focus Halo on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; font-family: 'Manrope Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-2, #44546a); } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #c3ced9); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink, #13212f); font: inherit; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; transition: border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6b7a8c; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #9fb0c1; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--navy-700, #1f4e79); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(58, 123, 200, 0.35); }

components.name: App Bar
components.description: Sticky 64px navy bar: white bean tile and wordmark, nav links with a 3px underline that grows from the centre on hover and stays solid when active.
components.html:
Weenie Beanie
HomeForecastLoansBeanstalk
components.css: .ds-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 28px; height: 64px; padding: 0 24px; background: var(--navy-900, #0e2a47); color: #fff; font-family: 'Manrope Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06), 0 6px 20px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); } .ds-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: #fff; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.15rem; letter-spacing: -0.02em; white-space: nowrap; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-bean-tile { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(14, 42, 71, 0.18); } .ds-bean-tile svg { transition: transform 500ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav { display: flex; align-self: stretch; gap: 4px; } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 12px; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.78); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem; text-decoration: none; transition: color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 12px; right: 12px; bottom: 0; height: 3px; border-radius: 3px 3px 0 0; background: #fff; opacity: 0.5; transform: scaleX(0); transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), opacity 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #fff; } .ds-nav-link:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav-link.is-active { color: #fff; } .ds-nav-link.is-active::after { transform: scaleX(1); opacity: 1; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible, .ds-brand:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #3a7bc8; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-icon-btn { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; margin-left: auto; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: #fff; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-icon-btn:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14); } .ds-icon-btn:active { transform: scale(0.94); } .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #3a7bc8; outline-offset: 2px; } @keyframes ds-bean-tip { 0%, 100% { transform: rotate(0); } 30% { transform: rotate(-8deg); } 65% { transform: rotate(6deg); } } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-brand:hover .ds-bean-tile svg { animation: ds-bean-tip 500ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-bean-tile svg { animation: none !important; } }

components.name: Bean Tile
components.description: Brand mark: white 12px rounded square holding the two-speck bean; wobbles once on pointer hover.
components.css: .ds-bean-tile-lg { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface, #fff); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(14, 42, 71, 0.18); } .ds-bean-tile-lg svg { transition: transform 500ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } @keyframes ds-bean-tip-lg { 0%, 100% { transform: rotate(0); } 30% { transform: rotate(-8deg); } 65% { transform: rotate(6deg); } } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-bean-tile-lg:hover svg { animation: ds-bean-tip-lg 500ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-bean-tile-lg svg { animation: none !important; } }

components.name: Action List
components.description: Acorns-style rows in a 16px Resting card: icon tile coloured by meaning, bold verb, tabular amount, chevron. Pointer hover washes Mist Navy, nudges the chevron 4px and scales the tile 1.06.
components.html:
• Cover August 2027$212.40
  • Grow your beanstalk
  • Check your claimed bean
components.css: .ds-actions { max-width: 420px; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--surface, #fff); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(14, 42, 71, 0.06), 0 8px 24px -8px rgba(14, 42, 71, 0.12); overflow: hidden; font-family: 'Manrope Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-actions ul { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-actions li + li { border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #dfe5eb); } .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; min-height: 64px; padding: 12px 16px 12px 20px; color: var(--ink-2, #44546a); font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-row:hover { background: var(--navy-50, #edf3f8); } .ds-row:active { background: var(--navy-100, #dbe6f1); } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px var(--focus, #3a7bc8); } .ds-tile { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; flex: none; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--navy-50, #edf3f8); color: var(--navy-700, #1f4e79); transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-tile--grow { background: var(--green-50, #e9f4ed); color: var(--green-700, #2e7d4f); } .ds-tile--bean { background: var(--bean-wash, #f7ece0); color: var(--bean-dark, #7f5226); } .ds-tile--warn { background: var(--amber-50, #fff3df); color: var(--amber, #8a5200); } .ds-row-text { flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-row-text strong { color: var(--ink, #13212f); font-weight: 700; } .ds-row-amount { color: var(--ink, #13212f); font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-chevron { flex: none; color: var(--ink-3, #5b6b7e); transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-row:hover .ds-chevron { transform: translateX(4px); color: var(--navy-900, #0e2a47); } .ds-row:hover .ds-tile { transform: scale(1.06); } }

components.name: Progress Track
components.description: 10px pill track toward the next tier; Growth Green fill fading to Sprout at its leading edge, with a value bubble riding the end.
components.html:
2 leaves
Tier 1 · $5003 until Tier 2
components.css: .ds-progress { display: grid; gap: 8px; max-width: 420px; padding-top: 26px; font-family: 'Manrope Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-progress-bar { position: relative; height: 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--line, #dfe5eb); } .ds-progress-fill { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: inherit; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--green-700, #2e7d4f) calc(100% - 24px), var(--green-600, #3d9a5f)); transition: width 600ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-progress-bubble { position: absolute; bottom: calc(100% + 8px); transform: translateX(-50%); padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--green-700, #2e7d4f); color: #fff; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; transition: left 600ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-progress-bubble::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 100%; left: 50%; border: 4px solid transparent; border-top-color: var(--green-700, #2e7d4f); transform: translateX(-50%); } .ds-progress-labels { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; color: var(--ink-3, #5b6b7e); font-size: 0.875rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-progress-fill, .ds-progress-bubble { transition: none; } }

components.name: Status Chips
components.description: Loan state pills; colour bound to meaning.
components.html: ActiveRepaidRepayment pausedDefaulted
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'Manrope Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-status--calm { background: var(--navy-50, #edf3f8); color: var(--navy-700, #1f4e79); } .ds-status--good { background: var(--green-50, #e9f4ed); color: var(--green-700, #2e7d4f); } .ds-status--warn { background: var(--amber-50, #fff3df); color: var(--amber, #8a5200); } .ds-status--bad { background: var(--red-50, #fcedec); color: var(--red, #b3261e); }

components.name: Offer Card
components.description: Lifted 16px decision card: illustration strip (soil and a waiting bean on Stalk Ground), headline, AI why-note, hairline terms, then Grow and Secondary pills.
components.html:
Cover August 2027 with $250.00

Your insurance payment lands in August, the month after your bonus is spent.

You receive
$250.00 at the start of August 2027
Flat fee
$5.00, no interest
Auto-repayment
$255.00 at the end of October 2027
components.css: .ds-offer { display: grid; gap: 18px; max-width: 460px; padding: 24px; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink, #13212f); font-family: 'Manrope Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(14, 42, 71, 0.08), 0 16px 40px -12px rgba(14, 42, 71, 0.28); overflow: hidden; } .ds-strip { display: block; width: calc(100% + 48px); height: 64px; margin: -24px -24px 0; background: var(--stalk-ground, #f3f8f4); } .ds-offer-title { margin: 0; font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-why { display: flex; gap: 10px; margin: 0; padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--navy-50, #edf3f8); font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-why svg { flex: none; margin-top: 3px; color: var(--navy-700, #1f4e79); } .ds-terms { display: grid; margin: 0; } .ds-terms > div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(7.5rem, max-content) 1fr; gap: 16px; padding: 10px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #dfe5eb); } .ds-terms > div:last-child { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #dfe5eb); } .ds-terms dt { color: var(--ink-3, #5b6b7e); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-terms dd { margin: 0; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-offer-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; } .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 22px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; font: inherit; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.95rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-pill:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #3a7bc8; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-pill--grow { background: var(--green-700, #2e7d4f); color: #fff; } .ds-pill--grow:hover { background: var(--green-600, #3d9a5f); } .ds-pill--secondary { background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--navy-900, #0e2a47); border-color: var(--line-strong, #c3ced9); } .ds-pill--secondary:hover { background: var(--navy-50, #edf3f8); border-color: var(--navy-700, #1f4e79); }

components.name: Link Card
components.description: Interactive 16px card (beanstalk preview, loan rows). Pointer hover lifts 2px to the Lifted shadow over 200ms; press settles at scale 0.99. Information cards never lift.
components.css: .ds-link-card { display: grid; gap: 6px; max-width: 320px; padding: 24px; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink, #13212f); font-family: 'Manrope Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(14, 42, 71, 0.06), 0 8px 24px -8px rgba(14, 42, 71, 0.12); transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-link-card h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-link-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--ink-3, #5b6b7e); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-link-card:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.99); } .ds-link-card:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #3a7bc8; outline-offset: 2px; } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-link-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(14, 42, 71, 0.08), 0 16px 40px -12px rgba(14, 42, 71, 0.28); } }

components.name: Bean Claim
components.description: Bean Wash row inside an open loan card: bean tile plus copy; the bean is claimed, not yet planted.
components.html: Bean claimed. Repay on time in October and it's planted as a new leaf.
components.css: .ds-bean-claim { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: center; max-width: 420px; padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--bean-wash, #f7ece0); color: var(--ink, #13212f); font-family: 'Manrope Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; } .ds-claim-tile { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; flex: none; width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface, #fff); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(14, 42, 71, 0.18); } .ds-bean-claim p { margin: 0; }

components.name: Beanstalk
components.description: Signature SVG: one segment and leaf per on-time repayment; tier marks at 2 and 5 leaves; soil base on Stalk Ground. Leaves sway on pointer hover only.

components.css: .ds-beanstalk { display: block; width: 200px; height: auto; overflow: visible; font-family: 'Manrope Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; background: var(--stalk-ground, #f3f8f4); border-radius: 16px; } .ds-stalk { fill: none; stroke: var(--green-700, #2e7d4f); stroke-width: 6; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-leaf { fill: var(--leaf, #7db665); stroke: var(--green-700, #2e7d4f); stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-leaf-g { transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: left center; } .ds-vein { fill: none; stroke: var(--green-700, #2e7d4f); stroke-width: 1; opacity: 0.7; } .ds-soil { fill: var(--soil, #4e3b2c); } .ds-tier line { stroke: var(--line-strong, #c3ced9); stroke-width: 1; } .ds-tier text { fill: var(--ink-3, #5b6b7e); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-tier.is-reached line { stroke: var(--green-700, #2e7d4f); opacity: 0.45; } .ds-tier.is-reached text { fill: var(--green-700, #2e7d4f); } @keyframes ds-leaf-sway { from { transform: rotate(-3deg); } to { transform: rotate(4deg); } } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-beanstalk:hover .ds-leaf-g { animation: ds-leaf-sway 1600ms ease-in-out var(--d, 0ms) infinite alternate; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-leaf-g { animation: none !important; } }

components.name: Toast
components.description: Lifted 16px live-update toast with meaning-coloured icon and dismiss.
components.html: Your beanstalk grewAn on-time repayment planted a new leaf.
components.css: .ds-toast { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 20px 1fr 40px; gap: 12px; align-items: start; width: min(380px, 100%); padding: 14px 8px 14px 16px; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--surface, #fff); font-family: 'Manrope Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(14, 42, 71, 0.08), 0 16px 40px -12px rgba(14, 42, 71, 0.28); animation: ds-rise 320ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-toast-icon { margin-top: 2px; color: var(--green-700, #2e7d4f); } .ds-toast-text { display: grid; gap: 2px; font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--ink-2, #44546a); } .ds-toast-text strong { color: var(--ink, #13212f); } .ds-toast-close { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; margin-top: -8px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-2, #44546a); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-toast-close:hover { background: var(--navy-50, #edf3f8); color: var(--navy-900, #0e2a47); } .ds-toast-close:active { transform: scale(0.94); } .ds-toast-close:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #3a7bc8; outline-offset: 2px; } @keyframes ds-rise { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-toast { animation: none; } }

narrative.northStar: A Bank That Grows a Bean
narrative.overview:
Weenie Beanie stands on Capital One's foundations: a deep night-navy shell, a cool near-white ground, white work surfaces, bold plain controls and nothing that looks like a toy. Into that shell it brings the warmth of habit-building money apps such as Acorns, where the whole interface revolves around one small growing thing. Here that thing is the bean and its beanstalk: the brand mark, the unit of progress and the reward. Every screen shows where the customer's bean is: claimed, planted, or grown into leaves.

Home opens with a navy hero band that greets the customer by time of day and states the answer in one Display sentence, with leaves growing into the band from the right; the first cards overlap its lower edge. Below sit Acorns-style action lists (icon tile, bold verb, amount, chevron), a pill progress track with a riding value bubble, pill buttons including the green Grow action, illustration strips of soil and bean on bean-related cards, and the white bean tile as the app icon. Cards are 16px, tiles 12px.

Everything a customer can act on responds: cards lift, rows wash and their chevrons step forward, leaves sway, the bean wobbles. Hover motion is gated behind (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine), so touch gets press states instead, and reduced motion removes transforms while keeping colour. The system refuses the KPI-tile dashboard, the scroll-everything page, neon or crypto styling, confetti for borrowing and jokey copy. It shows no Capital One logo; the footer line "Built on Capital One services" is the only reference.
keyCharacteristics: Navy app bar, then a navy hero band on Home whose lower edge the first cards overlap by 64px.
One plain status sentence at Display size inside the hero; a shortfall amount turns Red on Navy (#ff9b93), a covered sentence stays white.
Action-list cards with 12px icon tiles, bold verbs and chevrons; every row is a link or button and responds on hover.
Green means growth (beanstalk, progress fills, reached tiers, Grow button); tan is only the bean; red and amber only for trouble.
Pill buttons, 16px cards, 12px tiles; Lucide line icons; tabular figures.
One illustrated world (leaves, bean, soil, stalk) shared by hero, beanstalk, empty states and bean-related cards; never behind data.

rules.name: The Growth Is Green Rule
rules.body: Green appears only where something grew, will grow, or went right: the beanstalk, progress toward the next tier, reached tiers, repaid loans, the Grow action. It is never a generic brand accent.

rules.name: The Bean Is Tan Rule
rules.body: Tan belongs to the bean and nothing else. If a surface is tan, a bean is on it.

rules.name: The Alarm Budget Rule
rules.body: Red and amber appear only for shortfall, late, safeguard and default states. A calm screen has no red on it.

rules.name: The Answer Is the Headline Rule
rules.body: Display size is reserved for the hero sentence. Nothing else on the page is larger.

rules.name: The Bold Verb Rule
rules.body: Action rows start with a bold verb that names what happens ("Cover February", "Grow your beanstalk"); the rest of the phrase is quieter.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Every amount, date and count uses tabular figures, including chart ticks and progress bubbles.

rules.name: The Two Heights Rule
rules.body: There are two shadow heights only. Hover borrows Lifted; it never invents a third.

rules.name: The Honest Lift Rule
rules.body: Only surfaces that do something on click lift on hover. Information cards stay still, so lifting always means clickable.

rules.name: The Responsive Surface Rule
rules.body: Everything actionable answers the pointer within 120–200ms on the ease-out curve: at most 2px lift, 4px slide, 6% scale, or one colour step. Only transform, opacity, background-color, box-shadow and color animate; never transition: all. Hover motion is gated by (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine).

dos: Do open Home with the navy hero band: greeting, one answer sentence, leaves on the right, and cards overlapping its lower edge.
Do build navigation-style lists as action rows: icon tile, bold verb, amount, chevron.
Do show progress toward the next tier as a pill track with a value bubble.
Do use the green Grow pill only for actions that plant or grow the bean.
Do make every clickable surface respond on hover (lift, wash, nudge, sway) and on press (scale 0.98), within 200ms.
Do keep the leaf-and-bean illustration to the hero, beanstalk, bean-related cards, empty states and the brand tile.
Do set every figure tabular and keep controls at least 44px (40px for icon buttons).
Do honour reduced motion and touch: no hover-only information, and no motion without a static equivalent.
donts: Don't build KPI-tile dashboards or scroll-everything pages.
Don't lift information cards that do nothing on click.
Don't use green for anything that didn't grow, or tan for anything that isn't a bean.
Don't put red or amber on a calm screen.
Don't put illustration behind numbers, tables or charts.
Don't add uppercase eyebrows or kickers, gradient text, glass, or neon.
Don't show a Capital One logo; the footer line is the only reference.
Don't celebrate borrowing. Growth is celebrated only when a repayment plants the bean.
